faq_q1: What happens if my shop internet goes down for 3 days?
faq_a1: Nothing stops. Your billing, stock deduction, thermal printing, and party khatas run 100% inside your shop computer. You can print 5,000 bills with the internet cable unplugged.
faq_q2: What if my computer hard disk crashes or catches a virus?
faq_a2: ScaleERP creates a daily local backup zip on your PC and automatically uploads an encrypted copy to your personal Google Drive at 2:00 AM. If you change your PC, we restore your entire business down to the last rupee in 5 minutes.
faq_q3: My counter staff only reads Marathi or Hindi. Can they use this?
faq_a3: Yes. You can switch the entire software screen and printed customer receipts to Marathi or Hindi in one click. It is designed so a newly hired clerk can learn billing in 15 minutes without any accounting background.
